reason: £300 is a lot on £19k a year to send to someone with no reviews, and collection from a stranger's home feels risky. I'd keep scrolling Marketplace for a cheaper set.
objection: New seller with no reviews. I'd be handing over £300 cash or a bank transfer to someone I can't check, and a 7-day return only works if they actually take them back.
would_change_my_mind: Photos of real finished sets with a few genuine reviews, or paying only when I collect and can look over the wheels, at a lower price around £200.
